loginLead: Go to agentup.me to sign in or register.
loginCardBody: Opens agentup.me. You’ll return here when done.
loginOpening: Finish signing in on the web page…
loginFailed: Sign-in did not finish. Please try again.
loginDesktopOnly: Sign in from the desktop app
authReasonPublish: Publishing an agent needs an account so ownership can be bound to you. After sign-in, the previous step continues.
authReasonRecruit: Recruiting a market agent needs an account. After sign-in, recruitment continues.
authReasonHostedModel: AgentUp-hosted models require sign-in. Your own local model or provider API key does not.
appearanceGuestLead: While signed out, language and theme stay on this device.
appearanceAccountLead: While signed in, language and theme come from this account.
themeSystemHint: Match the system light or dark appearance
chatSettingsMcpEmpty: This assistant has no MCP servers yet.
threadNewFailed: Could not start a new chat
threadNewBody: Earlier messages stay on screen, but the model will not see them from the next message. Local work files are left as they are.
threadRemarkBody: The remark belongs to your account and does not change the agent's name. Leave it empty to show the original name.
threadClearBody: This permanently deletes this agent's local conversation history, including the sidebar preview. Files in the work folder stay. This cannot be undone.
threadDismissBody: This removes the recruit and permanently deletes this agent's local data, including chats and work products. The published agent itself is unchanged.
threadEmptyNeedSync: Sync this package version from the conversation menu, then start chatting.
threadEmptyNeedRecruit: Recruit {name} from the Agent market to add it to your conversations.
threadEmptyPickOrRecruit: Pick an agent from the conversation list, or recruit one from the Agent market.
accountGuestLead: You are a guest. Sign in to sync this device's guest data to your account.
accountLead: Display details for this account. The sign-in email cannot be changed.
accountGuestBody: Guests use the default avatar. Sign in to upload an avatar, send messages, and recruit or publish agents.
sideEmpty: No conversations yet. Recruit an agent from the market.
sideRecruitNudgeTitle: You haven’t recruited other agents yet
sideRecruitNudgeBody: Recruit from the market, or add a local agent — they’ll show up in this list.
composerNeedModelBody: Connect a provider and enable models in Settings, then pick which model this conversation uses next to Send.
composerNeedSync: Sync the package from the conversation menu to continue.
composerNeedRecruit: Recruit this agent from the market to continue.
composerPlaceholder: Send a message, type / to insert a Skill…
composerModelPickerAria: Choose the model for this conversation
agentsEmptyOwned: You have not published an agent yet.
agentsEmptyLocal: No local helpers yet. Add a name and short description to start chatting. You can publish to the market later if you want.
agentsGuestLocked: Sign in to see recruited agents and what you have published.
agentsLocalCreateDesc: Set a name, role, and background. Work rules, skills, and MCP are optional.
agentsLocalEditDesc: Update identity or advanced settings. Changes apply immediately.
agentsLocalNotFound: This local helper was not found
agentsLocalBackgroundPlaceholder: Describe its experience, expertise, and working style
agentsLocalBackgroundHint: Up to 300 characters. Combined with the name and role to define the agent identity.
agentsLocalAdvancedHint: Configure work rules, Skills, and MCP. Most users can skip this.
agentsLocalRulesHint: Plain text or Markdown, saved as AGENTS.md work rules.
agentsLocalSkillsHint: Upload a Skill folder or ZIP that contains SKILL.md into this agent’s skills/.
agentsLocalSkillNeedDesktop: Pick a Skill package in the AgentUp desktop app
agentsLocalAvatarHint: Optional. Pick an official avatar, or upload your own. Shows the name initial when empty. Compressed on upload; PNG, JPEG, or WebP.
assistantAvatarHint: Pick an official avatar, or upload your own. Uses the default portrait until you choose one. Compressed on upload; PNG, JPEG, or WebP.
agentsLocalAvatarFailed: Could not process avatar; try another image
agentsLocalMcpHint: Configure mcpServers: each server must set either command or url (not both).
agentsLocalMcpJsonInvalid: MCP config is not valid JSON
agentsLocalMcpObjectInvalid: MCP config must be a JSON object (mcpServers map)
agentsLocalNeedDesktop: Open the folder in the AgentUp desktop app
agentsLocalDeleteDesc: This deletes “{name}” and its chat history. This cannot be undone.
assistantBackgroundHint: Up to 300 characters describing experience, expertise, and working style.
assistantAdvancedHint: Skills, work rules, and MCP apply only to your personal assistant—not to market agents.
assistantSkillsHint: Upload a Skill folder or ZIP with SKILL.md for your personal assistant only.
msgError: Something went wrong while replying. Please try again.
modelUnavailable: The current model service is unavailable. Please try switching models.
assistDismissed: This agent was dismissed, so the conversation cannot be opened
assistNoTaskId: Cannot open the run (missing task id)
approvalBgRunTitle: Run a command in the background
approvalBgRunDesc: After you allow it, the command runs in the background so you can keep chatting.
artifactTruncated: Many changes this turn; showing a limited list.
shellHangTitle: This command has been running for about {seconds}s
shellHangDesc: It may be stuck. Keep waiting, or stop this step.
accountAvatarHint: Shown in the nav menu and chat bubbles. PNG, JPEG, or WebP.
accountEmailHint: Used for sign-in and cannot be changed
accountNicknameHint: Shown in the avatar menu. Saves when you leave the field.
accountLogoutHint: Return to guest. Account data stays on this device.
assistantLead: Your private assistant only. Its background, skills, work rules, and tools are not shared with market agents.
assistantNameHint: Shown in the conversation sidebar and chat header. A personal name stays on your account.
assistantRoleHint: Describe the position this assistant fills.
personalAssistantSummary: Uses only the skills, work rules, and tools you configured for your private assistant.
assistantProfileRequired: Name, role, and background are required
assistantAvatarType: Avatar must be PNG, JPEG, or WebP
skillsLeadBefore: Upload a Skill folder or ZIP, or import from a community registry—private assistant only, not market agents. Separate from
skillsCommunityLead: Search public skill registries and install locally. Default source is SkillHub.
skillsEmptyBody: Search the community, or pick a folder / ZIP that contains SKILL.md.
rulesLead: Habits, tone, and notes for your private assistant only. Market agents are unaffected.
rulesPlaceholder:
# Private assistant rules

- Keep answers concise
- Explain intent before editing files
rulesHint: Plain text or Markdown. Clearing the field and leaving deletes it. Saves automatically for the next turn.
mcpLead: Connect calendars, notes, databases, and more for your private assistant. Calls still ask for local approval.
mcpHint: List services as JSON. Each needs either a command or a url. Saves when you leave the field.
providerLead: Enabled models show up next to Send so you can pick per conversation. Keys stay on this device.
providerApiKeyKeep: Leave blank to keep the saved key
providerAddModelToggle: Can't find the model you need? Try manual setup
providerAddModelLead: Enter the official model ID from the provider docs (e.g. glm-4.7-flash). It will appear in the list above.
providerAddModelExists: Model is already in the list
providerRemoveModelBuiltin: Built-in or discovered models can't be deleted; turn the switch off instead
providerEnvOverride: This process has model environment variables. You can still save here, but runtime prefers the environment.
providerGuestHint: Guests can configure this first; sending messages still requires sign-in.
providerEnableLead: Toggle to make a model available in chat; pick which one to use in the conversation.
providerNeedConnection: Expand below to connect a provider first. Models will appear here.
providerPlatformBody: After sign-in you can use hosted models without bringing your own key.
wsDeleteOne: Permanently delete “{name}”. This cannot be undone.
wsDeleteMany: Permanently delete {n} selected items. This cannot be undone.
wsTooLarge: File is too large to preview
publishLead: Fill in the card plus optional rules, skills, and MCP. We save a local draft and publish it to the market.
publishUpdateLead: Edit the card or advanced settings, then save. Card-only changes (including rules and avatar) skip a new package version; skills / MCP publish a new version.
publishDeleteDesc: This permanently removes “{name}” from the market. Recruited users will no longer receive updates. This cannot be undone.
publishDeleteConfirmLabel: Type the agent name to confirm
publishDeleteConfirmPlaceholder: Paste or type the full name
publishAdvancedHint: Rules save with the card; skills and MCP go into the package. Leave them empty when you are not changing capabilities.
publishValidateFailBody: Fix the issues below and try publishing again.
wsUnmountOne: Unmount “{name}”? The agent will no longer be able to read or write that folder.
wsNeedDesktop: Open this in the AgentUp desktop app
approvalCmdTitle: Run a command on this computer
approvalCmdDesc: It runs only after you allow it.
approvalDelegateDesc: After you allow it, your personal assistant can hand the task to a recruited agent.
approvalWriteTitle: Change a file on this computer
approvalWriteDesc: It changes only after you allow it, and only this once.
approvalProjectTitle: Access a folder outside the workspace
approvalProjectDesc: If you allow it, that folder is mounted as a project root so the agent can keep reading and writing.
approvalFetchDesc: It requests only after you allow it, and only this once.
approvalSearchDesc: It searches only after you allow it, and only this once.
approvalToolDesc: It continues only after you allow it, and only this once.
approvalMcpDesc: It continues only after you allow it. You can remember for this chat or this assistant.
sideAwaitChildAskGeneric: A specialist is waiting for your answer
